name: mailchannels
description: Add outbound transactional email to any app with MailChannels Email API, including password resets, sign-in links, receipts, invitations, notifications, alerts and verification mail. Use REST, SMTP, or official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs with Laravel, Symfony and Nodemailer transports. Delivery-event webhooks are signed, and sub-accounts provide isolated controls when customers or agents send through your app. The Email API does not receive inbound mail.
